name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - § 67/1
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: ‘Underlines the importance of the Southern Neighbourhood line in supporting political, economic and social reforms in the region and in meeting increased humanitarian needs as well as for other purposes of regional cooperation; proposes to increase appropriations for the line by EUR 35 million above the DB,’
